Name: Meta Platforms Inc.
Description: Meta Platforms, Inc. is a leading technology company based in Menlo Park, California, focused on building products and services that facilitate global connectivity and social interaction. Renowned for its social media platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, Meta is also heavily investing in virtual and augmented reality technologies through its Reality Labs division, positioning itself at the forefront of the metaverse. As it innovates in both consumer engagement and immersive experiences, Meta continues to attract a vast user base, driving advertising revenue and expanding its influence within the digital economy.
